issue_context.summary: The thumbnail-provider report now includes a current reproduction of a shell hang and persistent COM Surrogate CPU use. An open draft PR already targets bounded provider execution.
known_information: The original report names PowerToys 0.76 and does not provide deterministic reproduction steps.
The 2026-10-22 comment describes dllhost.exe remaining active for about 13 hours and identifies an unbounded wait for the renderer process.
The 2026-10-30 comment reports the mechanism on PowerToys 0.102.3001 and provides measurements from a stuck COM Surrogate.

Current main's src/modules/previewpane/FileExplorerDllExporter/ThumbnailProvider.cpp calls ShellExecuteEx, waits with WaitForSingleObject(m_process, INFINITE), and deletes the temporary input only after the wait returns.
Current main's PdfThumbnailProvider/Program.cs and SvgThumbnailProvider/Program.cs display a modal MessageBox when the helper receives the wrong number of arguments.
The issue is assigned to stefansjfw. PR #49950 is open, marked draft, and changes ThumbnailProvider.cpp; it has not been merged.
inferences: A helper that never exits can keep the COM provider call blocked and prevent Explorer from completing thumbnail work.
The invalid-argument MessageBox is a separate potential hang path; the issue evidence does not establish that it caused the reported normal thumbnail request.
issue_context.analysis: The current code confirms the unbounded wait described in the thread, and the recent reproduction shows the problem persists in a current release. PR #49950 is the appropriate existing fix path. The issue should remain open because the PR is still a draft and has not been verified as a released fix.
